remarks: Discover exceptional comfort and convenience in this beautifully maintained 1BR/1BA residence located in the sought-after Hayes House Condominiums. This spacious unit offers a rare combination of privacy & accessibility, complete with sweeping panoramic tree-line views for tranquil living. Inside, you'll find a well-designed open floorplan with warm wood-style flooring, soft neutral tones, and abundant natural light throughout. The expansive living room offers versatile space for entertaining, seamlessly flowing into a dedicated dining area perfect for everyday meals. The galley-style kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, white cabinetry, a tile backsplash & ample counter space. Retreat to the oversized bedroom, which easily accommodates a full furniture set & features two closets. The updated full bath offers a modern finish with a tub/shower combo. Additional highlights include a storage locker, designated garage space, guest parking, concierge, 24-hour security, on-site superintendent, gym, community room, shared courtyard with grills, bike storage, & laundry. HOA dues include heat, cooling, and hot water. Just steps from Downtown Stamford, this unbeatable location offers easy access to Metro North, I-95, parks, beaches, restaurants, shops, medical centers, & more. Whether you're looking for your primary home or a pied-a-terre, this inviting residence blends comfort, value, and convenience in one of Stamford's most desirable buildings.
